subject: Status: static-analysis repro done, new-task port slower than hoped
body:
Hi both,

Status for the week. The static-analysis repro is done: the GFSA layer trained end to end recovers the reference analysis on the demo-notebook task, matching the open-source result. Automaton-policy training is stable once we adopted the initialization from the new-task guide notebook.

The retrieval-flavored task is where time is going. Porting our hyperlink-style graphs into the GFSA input format needed more schema work than planned - Hyun estimates the first trainable version lands 5/20, two days behind the 5/22 milestone gate, so tight but ok.

Risk: on graphs above ~50k nodes the automaton unrolling blows past device memory on a single A100; we either shard or cap graph size for the LRB demo. I propose capping at 20k nodes for 6/11 and treating sharding as post-review work.

Fumiko
